about: Edmonton: Street names for each Edmonton lot’s map frame (project decision): per lot, the named streets within reach (half the lot’s longest side + 60 m), nearest first; lines and label anchor in the tiles’ frame (metres from the tile origin) and in the lot frame (u along the lot, v across; the site model’s and the plans’ frame); angleDeg kept between -90 and 90. Lanes and unnamed streets left out. Built by .
source: City of Edmonton Open Data, Road Network (STREET_NAME_FULL; downloaded 16 Oct 2026). Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Edmonton. Lot-frame fields left out (the lot frames come from licensed outlines).
